title: A tour to recommend
text:
The guide had a lot knowledge of the mountain and surrounding area. The tour was adapted to our request as we were the only two persons at the tour.
The guide came with nice alternatives and suggestions to fit our interests in the beginning of the tour. We can really recommend it. Fantastic views over the mountain.
author: Claes B

title: Hiking Sierra Nevada
text:
Carlos was a great guide. He was knowledgeable about the history of the area and knew the local trails well. 
The hike was challenging at times, gaining an altitude of almost 1000 m
author: Richie R

title: Pepe Tours day trip to Granada from Roquetas de Mar 13th June 2023
text: Fantastic trip to Granada from Roquetas de Mar with super knowledgeable driver/guide (Christian). Cost was 79 euros, worth every cent. The journey takes about 2 hours via Sierra Nevada with a short comfort/coffee break. Air-conditioned mini bus, all english commentary. We spent the morning at the Alhambra & got to see Nasrid places, alcazaba, Charles V Palace & Generalife gardens. Jet2 did a similar trip from our hotel but the Sunday trip had been cancelled due to low numbers and the Thursday trip wasn't guaranteed for same reason (that was 80 euros & didn't include as much. author: Savtraveller63

title: Highly Recommended!
text: This is a great day out of the city! You’ll learn so much about the area; including the geography, culture, agriculture, etc. and get some excellent exercise with impressive views of the mountains all around you. Our driver was Josè and he was extremely friendly, fun and informative. He doesn’t rush you, and always makes sure you’re comfortable and happy. On top of it all, we ate lunch at a beautiful restaurant that we never would have gone to without this trip and Jose. Be sure to follow their advice on what to bring and you’ll love your time on this tour!
author: CrystalS841

title: What a hike!!! Ask for Jose “The Goat”!
text: What an amazing hike. Jose, a.k.a., the goat, was a fantastic guide. We were the only two that showed up so it was a private tour. We had a blast and walked all the way to the top. Definitely dress in layers and bring sunscreen. Amazing views. Stopped at a fantastic restaurant at the bottom of the hill on the river, extremely authentic Spanish, food, and plenty of sangria.
author: 448mt

title: Sierra Nevada day trip
text: Had a fantastic day trip to Sierra Nevada with the knowledgeable Jose. What a beautiful place to visit in summer when there are few people around. Thanks Jose!
author: meganlL4408OM

title: Excursion Sierra Nevada.
text: Excursion to Sierra Nevada with Jose Bolivar as our taxi driver and guide. Superb experience. Good weather. Rich food. All perfect. Jose Bolivar a discovery, professional as a pine top, extraordinary person, an educated and cultured uncle, masters languages, funny, kind... Jose, you're a freak, really. Thank you very much. It will be unforgettable.
author: Vcxdfghj

title: Unforgettable moments
text: Sierra Nevada is an absolute must if you visit Granada and like mountains. Breathtaking views, unforgettable memories, warm-hearted people and unique diversity in scenery and weather. Special thanks to Mr. Jose Bolivar, who made this tour very special to us!
author: katiaandtommie

title: Sierra Nevada - what an experience
text: It is a worthwhile tour to make.  Great scenery especially since it had snowed right before our tour.  Just make sure to wear proper attire (check weather) and know that you will be walking up hill in rocky terrain.  It was just breathtaking.  The tour guide was knowledgeable and very eager to make sure all were pleased with the experience.  Must eat at Restaurante Maitena while you are there.
author: Vacation245088

title: Awesome
text: We booked a tour into the Sierra Nevada starting from Granada. Carlos our tour guide and driver prepared a very beautiful custom tour for us. He showed us amazing viewpoints, we did some hikes through the awesome scenery of the the sierra and talked about geology and history. It was super interesting and entertaining. That would normally the end of the review...but I forgot my glasses in Carlos' car and had a super tight time window for my departure from the airport.
